title: Vending Machine Dispenser
description: You are designing the cash return algorithm for a smart vending machine. Given an array of coin denominations available in the machine and a target amount of change to return, compute the fewest number of coins needed to make up that amount. If that amount of change cannot be made up by any combination of the coins, return -1.
input_format: An integer array coins and an integer amount.
output_format: An integer representing the minimum number of coins needed, or -1 if impossible.

examples.explanation: The amount of 3 cannot be formed using only 2-unit coins.
